summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against the selected Greek throughout paragraphs 1–8. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the carrying arrangements, building sequence, stone counts, color changes, separate negative conditions, removal order, and necessary passage through the gate by the virgins. The notes distinguish editorial supplements from preserved wording and disclose the reported numerical and shorter-reason alternatives without replacing the declared working readings. Their bounded comparison claims are compatible with the supplied project reports. Acceptance concerns these supplied drafts and disclosures only; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or editions, certify exhaustive collation, or establish a unique interpretation. Any proposed replacement would require fresh review.
